This page provides a way of sorting out the events, past and present, of the series according to the world's chronology. They are first sorted by [[Age]], with the [[Third Age]] being further subdivided into [[:Category:After the Breaking|After the Breaking]], [[:Category:The Free Years|The Free Years]] and the [[New Era]].

A partial timeline of events in the series and of previous Ages can be found [[Timeline|here]].
